verdict.rationale: Lithic documents an official MCP server at docs.lithic.com/docs/mcp. It connects AI assistants such as Cursor, Claude Code and Copilot so they can search docs, inspect endpoint schemas, generate code and execute live API requests, and a first-party blog post shows agentic payment workflows built on it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described, and documented setup, auth and transport details.
